attr.title: Samurai II: Vengeance
attr.desc: Unity 4.6.3p2 Mono Android port of Samurai II: Vengeance 1.1.4 for TrimUI Smart Pro 1.1.1 PortMaster. Original Madfinger game files are not included.
attr.inst: Copy Samurai II Vengeance 1.1.4 APK into Data/ports/samurai2/gamedata as samurai2-1.1.4.apk, run setup.ps1 on a PC, then launch.
